product.title: LG 65-inch NU87 4K TV
product.customers_say: Customers find the TV's picture quality impressive, with stunning 4K content, and consider it one of the best in the market. The performance receives mixed feedback - while some are very happy with it, others report issues with the webOS being sluggish. Sound quality and value for money also get mixed reviews, with some praising the sound while others find it lacking, and some considering it good for the price while others disagree. Installation experiences are mixed, with some reporting smooth installations while others have installation support delays. The remote control receives negative feedback, with customers describing it as the basic type, and display issues include black spots and blank screens.

feedback_topics.name: Quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers find the TV's quality excellent, with one customer noting its effective upscale algorithm for low-quality inputs.

feedback_topics.name: Picture quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers praise the TV's picture quality, particularly its impressive upscaling capabilities and stunning 4K content.

feedback_topics.name: Value for money
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the TV's value for money, with some finding it a very good product at this price, while others express dissatisfaction with their purchase.

feedback_topics.name: Performance
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the TV's performance, with some finding it satisfactory while others report issues with the webOS operating system being sluggish and having a very slow user interface.

feedback_topics.name: Sound quality
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed opinions about the TV's sound quality, with some finding it awesome, while others report it is not as good as expected.

feedback_topics.name: Installation
feedback_topics.text: Customers have mixed experiences with the TV's installation, with some finding it smooth and noting that the service is free, while others report issues with delayed support and missing mounting brackets.

feedback_topics.name: Remote control
feedback_topics.text: Customers are dissatisfied with the TV's remote control, describing it as basic and inconsistent, with one customer noting that it doesn't support all features.

feedback_topics.name: Display
feedback_topics.text: Customers report issues with the TV's display, including black spots, blank screens, and white patches.

limitations: Saved screenshot dataset, manually transcribed; no live Amazon collection occurs in Demo Mode.
Price and ratings reflect the supplied screenshots and may have changed.
Canonical URL and ASIN come from the user-supplied url.txt. Product title is shortened for display; specifications preserve the observed variant.
Customers Say and topic descriptions are secondary, AI-generated evidence. Topic mention counts are not failure rates.
Only partial topic-panel excerpts are supplied. Full review IDs, dates, star ratings and complete context are unavailable; no identifiable full written reviews were collected.
Excerpts may overlap or refer to different variants. Reported lifespan, performance and defect claims are not independently verified.
Seller specifications are recorded as claims, not independently verified measurements.
